name: student-job-portal
description: Student Job Portal MERN Stack Application

scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run install-all && npm run build --prefix frontend && node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('frontend/dist')) { fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'public', { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('frontend/dist', 'dist', { recursive: true }); }"
